title: Act: Add effectSchema and bedroom effects content
summary: Add effects to sceneSchema and author them in bedroom.yaml
description: Add effectSchema and an optional effects array to sceneSchema, export EffectSpec, and add dust, ambientLight and fade entries to bedroom.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: effectSchema is exported and sceneSchema.effects is optional
bedroom.yaml has one dust, one ambientLight and one fade effect

steps.action: Add a z.discriminatedUnion on 'type' with three variants: dust, ambientLight and transition
Add field `effects: z.array(effectSchema).optional(),` after objects, and export type EffectSpec = z.infer<typeof effectSchema>
Append top-level `effects:` with dust (asset effect:dust, count 20, area {x:0,y:0,width:320,height:180}), ambientLight (color '#ffd9a0', alpha 0.15) and transition (kind fade, durationMs 400)
steps.expected: File loads through the loader without errors
